topic: Methods of applying surface protection, preparation of paints, equipment used, common paint and troubles.
syllabus_extract: Methods of applying surface protection, preparation of paints, equipment used, common paint and troubles.
specific_objectives: 6.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand surface protection materials, paint identification, restoration of various paint and application, dope shop, dope articles and troubles.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of paint mixing and spray gun handling. Safety precautions: Ventilation, PPE usage. Instructor supervision: Direct observation.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of aircraft surface protection?
Name two common types of corrosion affecting aircraft structures.
Why is proper surface preparation critical before painting?

development.content:
Surface protection materials overview
Paint identification standards
Restoration of various paint types

Preparation of paints and thinners
Equipment used in painting
Dope shop operations

Common paint troubles and causes
Dope articles and usage
Troubleshooting paint defects

summary_questions: Explain the difference between primer and topcoat in surface protection.
Identify the cause of 'orange peel' defect in painted surfaces.
List the safety precautions required when using spray painting equipment.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a list of color codes and marking standards for naval aircraft to be discussed in the next lesson.

pft_rows.syllabus: Colors and marking on naval aircraft.
